ruleDefinitions.name: Regsvr32 DLL Execution With Suspicious File Extension
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of REGSVR32.exe with DLL files masquerading as other files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "REGSVR32\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bin$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bmp$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.cr2$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.eps$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.gif$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ico$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.jpeg$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.jpg$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.log$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.nef$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.orf$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.png$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.raw$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.rtf$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.sr2$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.temp$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.tif$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.tiff$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.tmp$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.txt$")))
